seo.title: Amara Hotel Limassol: Honeymoon Review (2026)
seo.description: Modern 5-star Limassol beachfront with infinity pools and Nobu sushi. Score 89/100, from €420/night. Best suite, 7-night plan, honest 2026 verdict.

content.verdict: Amara is the modern architectural standout of Limassol — a 2018 ground-up 5-star on the eastern beach strip that took the existing Cypriot luxury formula (sea-view balconies, multiple pools, a serious spa) and rebuilt it with floor-to-ceiling glass, minimalist white-and-grey palettes, and the kind of design vocabulary that reads closer to Greece's Costa Navarino than to traditional Cyprus. The defining feature is the architecture — every single room has an unobstructed sea view (a rare claim in the eastern Mediterranean), the pools are stacked across three terraces ending at the sand, and the lobby opens directly onto a beachfront restaurant strip that includes Matsuhisa Limassol (Nobu's Cyprus outpost, signature black-cod miso, beachside sushi at sunset). For honeymooners who want a modern, design-forward 5-star on the south coast with the Limassol Old Town dining scene 15 minutes away — Amara is the canonical choice, and its newer build typically delivers a more polished room product than the older Paphos seafront veterans.
content.best_room: Sky Villa with Private Pool — the top-floor villa category with a 12m heated private pool on the rooftop terrace, 360-degree sea views, separate living room and dressing room. The Deluxe Sea View Suite is the value entry at around €600/night with the same uninterrupted sea view and a generous balcony but no private pool. Avoid the Deluxe Sea View rooms (no separate living room) only if budget requires it — the sea view is universal across the property.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Arrival at Larnaca International
itinerary_7_nights.description: Direct to Larnaca (LCA), 45-minute transfer west to Limassol. Amara welcome at the lobby, room familiarisation, sunset dinner at Matsuhisa Limassol (Nobu — reserve before arrival). First evening on the suite balcony watching the sea.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Beach and Pool Reset
itinerary_7_nights.description: Late breakfast at Ouzeri (the all-day Cypriot restaurant), morning at the beachfront pool, lunch at Matsuhisa beachside. Afternoon at the Amara Spa (the only proper hammam in the Limassol resort cluster), evening at the Cape Bar.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Limassol Old Town Tasting Walk
itinerary_7_nights.description: 15-minute taxi to the Old Town for a 3-hour guided food walk — Limassol Castle, the carob warehouses, loukoumades stops, halloumi tastings, meze flight at Karatello, finishing commandaria at the wine bar above the castle. Return to Amara for sunset.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Aphrodite's Rock and Kourion
itinerary_7_nights.description: Day trip 35 minutes west to Petra tou Romiou (Aphrodite's Rock) for the morning swim, continuing to the Kourion archaeological site (Roman theatre on a cliff above the sea). Lunch at the seaside taverna Hondros below the site. Return to Amara by 5pm.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Troodos Day Trip
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 75 minutes north into the Troodos mountains — Omodos for lunch, Kykkos Monastery, Mount Olympus viewpoint at 1,952m. Cool mountain air, painted Byzantine chapels. Return to Limassol for an evening at the Marina restaurants.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Spa Day and Marina Dinner
itinerary_7_nights.description: Full rest day at Amara — 90-minute couples massage, hammam circuit, afternoon by the rooftop pool. Evening at the Limassol Marina (15-minute taxi) for dinner at Caprice or Pyxida — the marina yacht-club restaurant scene.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Departure
itinerary_7_nights.description: Final breakfast at Ouzeri, last swim, 45-minute transfer back to LCA. Amara checkout is gentle — request late checkout for afternoon flights.

caveats: Amara is on the eastern Limassol beach strip — a long boulevard with adjacent hotels and the strip can feel built-up. The hotel itself is private but the immediate context is not the wild Akamas or quiet Pissouri.
The beach is grey-sand (not the golden sand of Latchi or the white of the Cyclades) — typical for Limassol. Most guests prioritise the pools and use the beach for short swims.
Matsuhisa Limassol is fully booked 2+ weeks out in summer — reserve before arrival, not on arrival, especially for Friday and Saturday dinners.

faqs.question: Good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: Yes — Amara is the most modern and design-forward 5-star in Cyprus, and the universal sea view from every room is unique on the island. Sky Villa with Private Pool delivers a definitive Limassol honeymoon room.

faqs.question: Best time to visit?
faqs.answer: May, June, September, and October are ideal. July and August are peak heat (36°C) but Limassol's sea breezes still work; Amara stays operating year-round, which makes it an option for winter warmth too.

faqs.question: Book in advance?
faqs.answer: Sky Villa and Deluxe Sea View Suite categories book 4–5 months ahead for July–September. Matsuhisa Limassol reservations should be made before arrival.

faqs.question: Adults-only?
faqs.answer: No — Amara is family-friendly. The rooftop pool at the Sky Villa level is the de facto adults-only zone in practice. Couples wanting strict adults-only should look at Almyra in Paphos or Parklane's Edra adults-only pool.

faqs.question: Best room type?
faqs.answer: Sky Villa with Private Pool — the top-floor villas with a 12m rooftop private pool. The Deluxe Sea View Suite is the value entry with the same view and a generous balcony.

faqs.question: How to get there?
faqs.answer: Larnaca International (LCA) is 45 minutes by private transfer (€60–€90 each way) — the right airport for Limassol. Paphos (PFO) is 80 minutes west and only worth it for specific flight connections.
